description: React component for selecting and displaying event types in an installation step, including subcomponents for event type cards and groups, utilizing react-hook-form for form state management.

classes.name: EventTypeCard
classes.description: Component representing an individual event type with selection and metadata display.

classes.name: EventTypeGroup
classes.description: Component representing a group of event types, including a list of EventTypeCards.

classes.name: EventTypesStepCard
classes.description: Main component managing the display and interaction of event type groups and individual event types in the installation process.

methods.name: EventTypeCard
methods.description: Renders a card for an event type, including checkbox, title, description, and durations.

methods.name: EventTypeGroup
methods.description: Renders a group of event types with associated avatar and list.

methods.name: EventTypesStepCard
methods.description: Handles the overall event types selection step, including rendering groups and handling save/setup actions.
